text:
Alex: Heads up 1 - Support ticket #55102 from HealthLink. They expect interleaved structured frames (tool_call/tool_result) in streaming chat so their downstream webhook can act mid-turn.

support-bot: Ticket created: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/55102 1 - assigned to Alex.

Nora: Context: customer runs Dedicated. Their integration assumes we emit tool_call as a discrete JSON event when the model decides to call a tool, not only as a final fn_call. Demo blocked.

Diego: Quick ask: can you paste minimal example of expected vs actual?

Alex: Expected: 
{"event":"message","text":"Look up patient 892"}
{"event":"tool_call","name":"fetch_patient","args":{"id":"892"}}
{"event":"tool_result","result":{"age":42}}
{"event":"message","text":"Found it"}

Actual: token stream for message then a final fn_call at end-of-turn. No mid-stream event frames.

Nora: We prototyped RFC-321 (event-level stream) but it's not GA. Options:
- shim for Dedicated: emit escaped JSON as a token chunk to mimic event frame (1 sprint).
- opt-in negotiation header: server emits event frames only when client supports (2 sprints + SDK changes).
- full protocol change: make event frames default (4+ sprints).

Diego: Risks: PII in tool args, SDK & agent compatibility, telemetry changes. Need security/privacy sign-off if we surface tool args earlier.

Sam: Business note: HealthLink is in pilot, medium ARR. If we can do a Dedicated shim in 10 days we can unblock the demo.

Alex: Proposal: triage as RDW-3221 (healthlink-stream-events-shim). Ship Dedicated shim behind admin opt-in; run privacy checklist; start RFC work in parallel if >2 customers request.

Nora: I'll own the privacy review. Diego: can you prototype the shim? ETA 7 days?

Diego: Yes. Will post design and tests by EOD Tue.

Alex: Action items: create RDW-3221, link support ticket, set priority P2 (escalate to P1 if demo date confirmed).
